items.zh: 人们倾向於无视这些抱怨。
items.en: It's tempting to dismiss such moans.

items.zh: 音乐环绕着我，将凡俗事物隔离在外。
items.en: It surrounds me, keeps the mundane world out.

items.zh: 他向来衣着整洁素雅，合乎他的年龄和身份。
items.en: He was always neatly and quietly dressed in accordance with his age and station.

items.zh: 若漠视生活中的小确幸，你的世界将会黯然失色，枯燥乏味。
items.en: Don’t ignore small joys in life, or your world will become dull and lifeless.

items.zh: 近年来，该地区牛奶消耗量稳步提升，足见民众的健康意识已然深入人心。
items.en: Over recent years, milk consumption in this area has steadily risen, which clearly shows that people’s health awareness has taken deep root among the public.
